entities.name: Major General Stitch
entities.role: Head of ECAP and founder of DEW
entities.description: A military leader who orchestrated the public trial and false execution of Ethan to secure him for research.
entities.quote: The “old man” who orders Ethan’s arrest and public judgment is Major General Stitch, head of ECAP and secret architect of DEW. Stitch personally orchestrates the propaganda against Ethan

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A captive subject who was subjected to a public trial and fake execution orchestrated by Stitch.
entities.quote: Later, it’s Stitch’s men who retrieve Ethan’s body and move him into the white containment room, where they begin testing how the Sky Guardian Candidate reacts to restraint.

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: A person Ethan attempted to protect during his trial.
entities.quote: When Ethan finally erupts to protect Nyxia, Stitch whispers to an aide: “Note the surge. Mark the pattern before sedation.”

entities.name: ECAP
entities.description: A military organization headed by Major General Stitch.
entities.quote: The “old man” who orders Ethan’s arrest and public judgment is Major General Stitch, head of ECAP and secret architect of DEW.

entities.name: DEW
entities.description: A secret research organization founded by Stitch.
entities.quote: The “old man” who orders Ethan’s arrest and public judgment is Major General Stitch, head of ECAP and secret architect of DEW.

entities.name: Covenant
entities.description: A faction connected to the conspiracy involving ECAP and DEW.
entities.quote: This connects the Season 1 trial directly to the wider conspiracy: ECAP → DEW → Covenant.

timeline_events.title: The Chained Wind Trial
timeline_events.description: Major General Stitch orders the arrest and public judgment of Ethan to facilitate his capture for research.
timeline_events.quote: The “old man” who orders Ethan’s arrest and public judgment is Major General Stitch, head of ECAP and secret architect of DEW.
